premises.text: Aspiring music artists lack access to quality producers or cannot afford a music career
premises.evidence_span: they either don't have access to quality producers or they can't afford to pursue a career in music

premises.text: Producers with studio equipment lack artist relationships and discovery channels to monetize beats
premises.evidence_span: the problem for Tony is that he doesn't have relationships with artists to sell his production

premises.text: An all-in-one mobile marketplace/studio/social network lets users create original songs with producers for under $5
premises.evidence_span: Rekogram is an all-in-one mobile production marketplace, a recording studio, and a social network that allows our users to create original songs with award-winning music producers for under $5

premises.text: Users can discover beats, write, record, shoot video, and share across social networks on the same mobile flow
premises.evidence_span: Our users can discover beats, they can write songs to those beats, they can record songs to those beats, and they can also shoot a video to that song that they just created, and they can share it across all their social networks

premises.text: Producer subscription plus lease/sale take-rate and royalty split monetize the marketplace
premises.evidence_span: We basically charge producers $9.99 a month or $90 a year to upload our beats to our platform

premises.text: Affiliate marketers, field reps, and celebrity relationships drive downloads and promotion
premises.evidence_span: We currently have 10 affiliate marketing companies out there in the music space that are helping promote our application

premises.text: Unlike competitors, the platform relies on original content rather than major-label licensing
premises.evidence_span: we're not relying on major label licensing because we're an original content platform

value.text: Anyone can awaken their inner musician by creating and sharing original songs affordably on mobile
value.evidence_span: empowers anyone, regardless of where they live in the world or how much money they have, the ability to awaken their inner musician

secondary_value.text: Producers make money while artists gain access and save money
secondary_value.evidence_span: we make money for producers like Tony, and we provide access and save money for guys like Willie

causal_links.evidence_span: The solution to their problem is Rekogram
Rekogram solves both Tony and Willie's problems
create original songs with award-winning music producers for under $5
we take 20% of the in-app purchase, and we provide 50% of the royalties back to the producer
they're going to react by downloading the RecordGram app

notes: Discover/write/record/video/share treated as feature cascade of the mobile creation mechanism alongside the under-$5 marketplace offer. Producer subscription, take-rate, and royalty split folded as one commercial package (v1.3.1 price+structure). Competitor fundraising figures and team deal history excluded as traction/credentials. Fetty Wap story used as illustration of the dual-sided problem, not a separate premise.
